preferNullishCoalescing.note: Isolated from the aggregate ratchet so it stays honest (Phase 13 strict-index exposed 482 falsy-fallback sites, 210 -> 692). Re-measured 2026-09-04 (Phase 19) over ALL 301 remaining sites with the TypeScript compiler API -- resolve the operand, ask the checker for its type, then apply the test THAT SHAPE requires. The shape matters: `x || b` and `if (!x) x = b` diverge when the operand is falsy-but-not-nullish (0, "", false, 0n, NaN); `x !== undefined ? x : b` diverges ONLY when x can be null; `x === null ? b : x` ONLY when x can be undefined; a two-sided `x != null` guard never diverges. Applying the falsy test to every shape under-counts safe sites by 8. verifiedSafe = 6: the `a || b || c` chains previously withheld, plus two in seasonings/vinegars.ts that became classifiable once `properties: any` was typed -- note a FULL chain converts to `a ?? b ?? c` with no parentheses, since parens are only needed when `??` is mixed with `||`/`&&`. semantic = 290: they genuinely diverge, including `any`/`unknown` operands treated as diverging because a type that could hold anything could hold "" or 0. unclassified = 5: a limitation of the MEASURING TOOL, not the code -- the classifier matches nodes that START on the reported line and these are multi-line `||` expressions beginning earlier; counted separately rather than folded into semantic. NOTE: only `total` is enforced -- compareSubBaseline reads nothing else, and `--ratchet` spreads these three fields through unchanged, so they MUST be re-measured by hand whenever total moves.
